extracted.name: Air fryer baked camembert
extracted.description: Use your air fryer to make baked camembert to serve to guests. Serve with your choice of crudités to dip in - pigs in blankets are especially festive
ingredient_lines: few rosemary sprigs each cut into 3-4 pieces
selection of crudités to serve (why not make it festive and use pigs in blankets?)
instruction_lines: Heat the air fryer to 180C. Remove the lid from the camembert pack and unwrap it. Put the camembert back into the wooden container, but don’t put the lid back on.
Score the camembert and tuck in pieces of rosemary and slices of garlic. Cook in the air fryer for 10 mins, then serve with your choice of crudités to dip in.
